manifest.access_justification: Phase 9 validation bank: frozen model-selection evaluation cases (Agent 1 construction)
manifest.case_id_rule: setup_pair_id = family_index * cases_per_family + case_ordinal over families F00..F15
manifest.draw_rule: side draw = first attempt k with sample_setup(split, eval_bank_draw_seed(bank_version, family_id, case_ordinal, side, k), profile='neutral_v1').family_id == case family
manifest.family_purity: both sides of a case draw from the case's family
manifest.no_outcome_selection: construction plays no game and reads no strength signal; draws are rejected only for family identity
